parsed.note: Halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE is a legitimate optimization hyperparameter change that leaves the fixed evaluation untouched—training shards remain 0-9, disjoint from EVAL_SHARD 10—so val_bpb still measures real held-out quality (the post's 'depth-10' claim vs the config's DEPTH=4 is a reporting inconsistency, not a metric integrity problem).
